title: Deliver reliable letter-learning lessons from the reality-check bridge
description:
User-requested comprehensive TODO and implementation of the October13 reality check.
Creation gate: consumer is this user and the implementing agent; gate is completing every identified fix without losing subtasks; observed defects include lost profile scores, broken rounds and hanging tracing; retire active tracking when all acceptance criteria pass (retain completed history, no deletion).
Integrity exception not needed. Opportunity cost: resampler/profile fixes have higher value than prolonged tracker work; creation/polishing is bounded to one task graph, then code.
Checklist: B00–B16 below cover all32 vision goals. No capability credit for planning. Preserve all modes, vocabularies, optional neural path, themes, celebrations, profiles and parent tools. Physical handwriting/audio/device gates stay explicitly open unless tested.

title: B00: Retain runnable browser regressions and CI
description:
Background / observed defect:
No tests exist; npm build only echoes. Add an npm test command, pinned browser-test dependencies, automated static server, and CI. Cover the reproduced geometry hang, 15-question rounds, profile reload, settings, stale callbacks, and short screens. Keep tests beside fixes rather than green scaffolding.

Implementation and scope:
Implementation stays in index.html; retain single-file static deployment and all three modes. Add meaningful native browser/unit regressions with console/error logs, source revision, and expected/actual results. Synthetic geometry and synthetic microphone tests must be labelled; they do not prove real handwriting or physical-device pronunciation quality.
